evidence.why: Exact signature and unchanged x34 return.
Capture-entry snapshot and conversion of direction components into bounded translation increments.
Thresholded stick inputs assign -1/+1 direction codes.

facts.rationale: Preserves the demonstrated signature, field access and consumer role while removing the unsupported dimensionless claim. The input components are assigned direction codes by mash processing, rather than shown to be physical displacements.
facts.value: Read-only Koopa attribute getter with signature float(HSD_GObj* gobj), returning ftKoopaAttributes.x34. CaptureKoopa entry snapshots the result into the captive's movement scale. Maintenance multiplies thresholded direction codes by this value to obtain local joint-translation increments; a dimensionless interpretation is not established.
